title: Ordinary committed-input flow: tested commit + gitignore-respecting Git status as source identity, launcher dirty-before/after rule, run binding and acceptance on an item-bound passed result
outcome: In the ordinary committed-input flow, a test run's evidence counts for an item when the judged commit is the commit the run tested: the launcher records the tested commit (git-commit:<HEAD>) with Git status respecting .gitignore, refuses a dirty start and records any post-run dirt with an agent disposition; the run keeps its actual result and original claim/root binding (including under turn-gated control OFF); and acceptance consumes that item-bound passed result instead of a named-root sighting or capture. The genuine Engram grant-free typed-verification producer/consumer is a cross-project dependency for the end-to-end case. The staged-tree gate-to-landing lane is held separately pending the coordinator's resolution of Greg's A/B choice.
acceptance: C1. Identity. In the ordinary committed-input flow, all fresh TermAl source-identity producers use git-commit:<HEAD> and the existing pinned Git runner's status respecting the repository's .gitignore and .git/info/exclude. This includes engram_place_source_basis, engram_execution_source_basis and test-run registration. The run retains its actual tested commit. No content scan, fingerprint-equality condition, named-root sighting or capture remains an ordinary source-eligibility condition. Historical content-v1 records remain stored unchanged.

C2. Launcher rule. A dirty checkout before an ordinary run refuses its start; no test stage executes. A clean checkout after the run satisfies the source condition, subject to the actual test outcome. Dirt after the run preserves the observed paths and actual stage results and requires a recorded agent disposition with paths and reason before the result is eligible. Only harmless non-input debris may be accepted; tracked source changes, changed test/build inputs, changed commit or failed stages cannot be waived. A mismatch is never rewritten as equality. Ignored outputs/dependencies stay ignored; existing bootstrap and binary pins remain. The separately governed staged-tree gate-to-landing lane stays unchanged as one implementation seam pending the coordinator's resolution of Greg's A/B choice.

C3. Run binding. Through the existing registration, observation, evidence and result-settlement owners, the run retains its actual terminal result, tested commit and original host-pinned project/store/session/work/run/claim/root association, including under control OFF. Binding comes from valid matching claim/root proofs, not stale session focus or a retrospective association; a re-claimed or nonmatching root cannot inherit another claim's evidence. No turn or grant is invented, credit:none or prose is never promoted to verification, and no parallel registry, scheduler or ledger is added. The verification_record sender delivers only with the initiating session's existing valid Base credentials, which ordinary root naming establishes; it starts no advisory bind or renewal of its own, and without such credentials the same immutable record, key and association stay typed-pending. After a TermAl reload a control-OFF session's restored token is flagged for rebind and no supported Base path re-establishes it, so that session's pending records are not delivered by this change (partial control-OFF delivery, tracked in w-ee4f85deaf54; full control-OFF delivery also depends on w-212221c53e2c). The Engram grant-free typed-verification producer is an explicit cross-project dependency.

C4. Acceptance. Admission and consumption accept an applicable item-bound passed result meeting C1–C3 whose tested commit equals the judged commit and whose verification record the host itself has received from Engram. In this flow this replaces require_acceptance_named_root_sighting and the capture/later-turn remedies in acceptance_evaluation_api.rs, acceptance_named_root_sighting.rs and engram_source_roots.rs; a task with committed-input runs never falls back to the sighting, and a result whose record is not host-acknowledged is refused with a typed reason. Required check kinds, actual failures, result/item scope and review/landing rules remain. Valid evidence is reused without bookkeeping reruns; historical records and frozen in-flight requests remain unchanged. Where C3's delivery limit leaves a record pending, that result is not admitted until it is delivered. The end-to-end acceptance criterion is not complete until the genuine Engram producer/consumer path supports it.

C5. Evidence. Focused tests cover dirty-before refusal with no test execution; dirty-after pending disposition, harmless-debris disposition and rejection of source/input changes; ignored-only paths staying clean; actual commit and correct item binding under OFF, including re-claim and nonmatching-root cases; matching-commit acceptance without a sighting and different-commit refusal; and preservation of historical content-v1 records. The cross-project case exercises the real Engram counterpart or a provenance-preserved actual producer wire against the real consumer, not only self-consistent mocks. The full five-stage gate passes on the exact landing input and the independent review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.

The verification_record sender emits a record only for a run durably confirmed as registered with its work binding and named root; an unregistered, unconfirmed or artifact-only run never emits, proven by an executed regression (only_a_durably_registered_run_is_ever_recorded_never_an_unregistered_or_artifact_only_one or its successor).

The verification_record sender initiates no Engram bind, advisory intent or credential renewal. It uses only the initiating session's legitimately current Base credentials. If those credentials are unavailable or require recovery, it retains the original registered verification record, idempotency key and association as typed-pending; absence of credentials creates no sender-owned exclusion on source-root naming. Ordinary Base authority, naming eligibility and recovery remain unchanged. Fresh OFF delivery through ordinary naming, naming remaining available when the sender lacks credentials, and delivery of that same pending record after legitimate Base credential recovery are covered by executed regressions.
